terms.comment: Between too much and too little (Lewis & Short): of size, ability or worth. With a negative it turns into praise, nōn mediocris, “considerable” (see significant).

evidence: Cic. Fam. 5.12.4: modicum quoddam corpus, a book of moderate size (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: sunt bona, sunt quaedam mediocria, sunt mala plūra quae legis hīc: aliter nōn fit, Avīte, liber
phrases.english: some of what you read here is good, some average, more of it bad: there’s no other way to make a book, Avitus

sources: Lewis & Short: mediocris · Lewis & Short: modicus
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. normal, ordinary, average.
